description: No intrusion detection/prevention systems to detect unauthorized network activity.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Security and compliance teams Human resources and training departments Third-party service providers (TPSPs) Incident response teams

related_controls: 11.5 - Network intrusions and unexpected file changes are detected and responded to
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Verify deployment of IDS/IPS solutions at the CDE perimeter and critical internal points. Monitor for active alerting mechanisms, signature updates, and response procedures. Check for continuous monitoring coverage and alert review processes.
